body.query: which certification scheme applies for toys under IS 9873
body.answer:
**Recommended Scheme: Scheme I - Standard Mark (ISI Mark Certification)**

Products conforming to IS 9873 are covered under a mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) issued by the competent Central Ministry. Manufacturing, importing, distributing, or selling this product without a valid BIS license is prohibited under Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016. Certification must be secured under Scheme I (Standard Mark / ISI Mark).

- Applicable Scheme: Scheme I - Standard Mark (ISI Mark License)
- Governing Standard: IS 9873
- Statutory Order: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020)
- License Process: Requires complete factory quality control audit, verified in-house test infrastructure, and conforming laboratory test reports.
- Surveillance: Regular factory surveillance audits and random market sampling are mandated to maintain license validity.

Sources: [EV1]

body.query: what is the certification scheme for gold jewellery under IS 1417
body.answer:
**Recommended Scheme: Scheme IV (Hallmarking of Precious Metals)**

Precious metals including gold jewellery and artefacts under IS 1417 are governed by the statutory Hallmarking Scheme (Scheme IV) under Section 14 and 16 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. Certification is mandatory pursuant to the Gold and Gold Alloys Hallmarking Order, 2020. All articles must be certified and laser-marked with a 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID).

- Applicable Scheme: Scheme IV - Hallmarking Scheme for Precious Metals
- Governing Standard: IS 1417 (Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking)
- Statutory Order: S.O. 4345(E) / Third Amendment 2026 (Mandatory)
- Marking Requirements: BIS Standard Logo, Purity in Karat and Fineness (e.g., 22K916), Assaying & Hallmarking Centre (AHC) mark, and 6-digit HUID
- Manufacturer Scope: Registered jewellers selling to domestic consumers; testing is performed via authorized AHC assay centers.

label: Part B - R4 Test 1: IS 9873 Certification Process Checklist

body.query: how do I get certification for toys under IS 9873
body.answer:
**Certification Process & Checklist: IS 9873 (Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties)**

To obtain Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for IS 9873 (Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties), manufacturers must navigate a five-stage conformity assessment journey under the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018. This end-to-step procedure verifies factory quality management, test facility infrastructure, and product compliance against the governing Indian Standard before a license is granted.

**Step 1: Application & Documentation Submission**
   Prepare and submit the formal online application through the BIS Manakonline portal (Form-V under Scheme I). Pay the requisite application fee and upload verified corporate and technical documentation.
   - *Key Documentation*: Manufacturing facility layout and premises proof, List of manufacturing machinery and process flow chart, In-house testing equipment list with valid calibration certificates, Qualifications of designated Quality Control (QC) personnel, Trademark / brand authorization certificate
   - Ensure all in-house test equipment specified in the standard's Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT) is physically operational on site.

**Step 2: Factory Audit & Preliminary Inspection**
   A designated BIS Technical Officer conducts an on-site factory audit of the manufacturing unit. The auditor verifies production capability, quality control protocols, and competency of testing personnel.
   - *Key Documentation*: Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT) agreement, Raw material test certificates and vendor verification records, Calibration logs and maintenance registers
   - During the audit, the inspecting officer observes in-house testing of complete product parameters in accordance with the standard.

**Step 3: Sample Drawing & Laboratory Testing**
   The BIS inspecting officer draws independent random samples from the production line or finished goods storage. Samples are sealed and dispatched to authorized testing laboratories for complete type testing against IS 9873.
   - *Key Documentation*: Sample drawing counter-foil signed by the auditor and manufacturer, Independent laboratory test request dossier
   - Recognized Testing Facilities for IS 9873:
   -   * BIS Central Laboratory (CL) (Sahibabad, Uttar Pradesh) [Accreditation: NABL-TC-5001]
   -   * BIS Western Regional Laboratory (Mumbai, Maharashtra) [Accreditation: NABL-TC-5002]

**Step 4: Review of Test Reports & Grant of License (CML)**
   BIS technical scrutiny committees evaluate the factory inspection report and the independent test reports. Upon confirming complete conformity with all prescribed parameters, BIS issues the Certificate of Manufacturing License (CML).
   - *Key Documentation*: Grant of License Letter with unique 7-digit CML number, Official approval of the standard ISI Mark design and product packaging artwork
   - The licensee is assigned a unique CM/L (Certification Marks / License) number which must be displayed adjacent to the ISI monogram.

**Step 5: Surveillance, Quality Assurance & Renewal**
   Following the grant of license, the licensee must maintain regular production records and adhere to the SIT. BIS conducts periodic unannounced surveillance audits and draws market samples to ensure ongoing quality compliance.
   - *Key Documentation*: Annual license renewal application (Form-VI), Periodic production and marking returns, Marking fee calculation statement
   - Licenses are initially granted for 1 to 2 years and are renewable upon payment of marking fees and verification of consistent quality history.

claims.text: Certification Process & Checklist: IS 9873 (Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties)**

To obtain Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for IS 9873 (Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties), manufacturers must navigate a five-stage conformity assessment journey under the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
This end-to-step procedure verifies factory quality management, test facility infrastructure, and product compliance against the governing Indian Standard before a license is granted.

Step 1: Application & Documentation Submission**
   Prepare and submit the formal online application through the BIS Manakonline portal (Form-V under Scheme I).
Pay the requisite application fee and upload verified corporate and technical documentation.

*Key Documentation*: Manufacturing facility layout and premises proof, List of manufacturing machinery and process flow chart, In-house testing equipment list with valid calibration certificates, Qualifications of designated Quality Control (QC) personnel, Trademark / brand authorization certificate
   - Ensure all in-house test equipment specified in the standard's Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT) is physically operational on site.

Step 2: Factory Audit & Preliminary Inspection**
   A designated BIS Technical Officer conducts an on-site factory audit of the manufacturing unit.
The auditor verifies production capability, quality control protocols, and competency of testing personnel.

*Key Documentation*: Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT) agreement, Raw material test certificates and vendor verification records, Calibration logs and maintenance registers
   - During the audit, the inspecting officer observes in-house testing of complete product parameters in accordance with the standard.

Step 3: Sample Drawing & Laboratory Testing**
   The BIS inspecting officer draws independent random samples from the production line or finished goods storage.
Samples are sealed and dispatched to authorized testing laboratories for complete type testing against IS 9873.

*Key Documentation*: Sample drawing counter-foil signed by the auditor and manufacturer, Independent laboratory test request dossier
   - Recognized Testing Facilities for IS 9873:
   -   * BIS Central Laboratory (CL) (Sahibabad, Uttar Pradesh) [Accreditation: NABL-TC-5001]
   -   * BIS Western Regional Laboratory (Mumbai, Maharashtra) [Accreditation: NABL-TC-5002]

Step 4: Review of Test Reports & Grant of License (CML)**
   BIS technical scrutiny committees evaluate the factory inspection report and the independent test reports.
Upon confirming complete conformity with all prescribed parameters, BIS issues the Certificate of Manufacturing License (CML).

*Key Documentation*: Grant of License Letter with unique 7-digit CML number, Official approval of the standard ISI Mark design and product packaging artwork
   - The licensee is assigned a unique CM/L (Certification Marks / License) number which must be displayed adjacent to the ISI monogram.

Step 5: Surveillance, Quality Assurance & Renewal**
   Following the grant of license, the licensee must maintain regular production records and adhere to the SIT.
BIS conducts periodic unannounced surveillance audits and draws market samples to ensure ongoing quality compliance.

*Key Documentation*: Annual license renewal application (Form-VI), Periodic production and marking returns, Marking fee calculation statement
   - Licenses are initially granted for 1 to 2 years and are renewable upon payment of marking fees and verification of consistent quality history.
